name: Aarti Pharmalabs Ltd
title: Aarti Pharmalabs Ltd - 543748 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 9% to Rs580 Cr but FY26 PAT fell to Rs176 Cr from Rs257 Cr as Atali ramp-up costs and West Asia inflation hit margins; management guides 15-18% growth with no near-term margin relief.

utilisation.quote: we are fully utilizing this capacity

capex.quote: we plan to maintain a similar level of spending for the FY 2027

triggers.label: Capex ~Rs400 Cr held for FY27
triggers.quote: we plan to maintain a similar level of spending for the FY 2027

triggers.label: API price increases resisted on existing orders
triggers.quote: the customers have resisted giving the price increase because these are all high value and low volume projects

triggers.label: Xanthine price rise via Chinese rebate removal
triggers.quote: I think Chinese rebate was close to 11% or 13% and that is what I think overall the price has increased due to that

triggers.label: Xanthine capacity 6,000 MT fully utilised
triggers.quote: we are fully utilizing this capacity

triggers.label: Growth guide 15-18% over 3-4 years
triggers.quote: we are targeting 15% to 18% growth in both revenue and EBITDA for next three, four years

guidance.value: 15% to 18% per annum over next 3-4 years
guidance.quote: we are targeting 15% to 18% growth in both revenue and EBITDA for next three, four years
we expect the CDMO /CMO business to lead the growth with a projected sales growth of 40% to 50% per annum
we plan to maintain a similar level of spending for the FY 2027
we anticipate capex turn of 1.5x to 2x

red_flags.label: Margin compression: PAT down ~31% FY26
red_flags.quote: the profit after tax stood at Rs .176 Crores versus Rs .257 Crores in FY 2025

red_flags.label: Working capital stress from CDMO inventory
red_flags.quote: these large customers do not pay us advance. So we have to finance this inventory ourselves.

red_flags.label: API price increases resisted by customers
red_flags.quote: the customers have resisted giving the price increase
